process_area.title: Tax Credit Recovery, Registry Reporting & Audit Defense

value_stream.name: Mandatory Discount, Eligibility & Tax Credit Recovery

workflows.name: SC/PWD/Solo Parent Tax Credit Computation & Monthly Claim Buildup

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "discount amount and associated VAT component from mandatory book per entity/month" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "Tax Accountant computes tax-credit-claimable amount" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System rule-based auto-approval of "approves monthly claim buildup" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-486 (ensure controlled execution — Tax Credit Recovery, Registry Reporting & Audit Defense (PA-85.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Recovery risk**: Under-claim forfeits rightful credit; mitigated by ERP-aggregated computation
System Touchpoints: - Mandatory book aggregation; tax-credit receivable GL; VAT return integration

steps.activity: ERP aggregates SC/PWD/Solo Parent discount amount and associated VAT component from mandatory book per entity/month
Tax Accountant computes tax-credit-claimable amount (discount treated as deductible from gross sales or VAT output per BIR rules); validates computation methodology
Tax Manager approves monthly claim buildup; books tax-credit receivable; integrates into VAT return computation

fields.Participants: Tax Manager, Tax Accountant, Store Manager

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validates against POS register" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "Tax Manager prepares quarterly SC/PWD Book-of-Sales summary report per" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-submit of "submits the SC/PWD quarterly summary to BIR/DOF" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-486 (ensure controlled execution — Tax Credit Recovery, Registry Reporting & Audit Defense (PA-85.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Late or incomplete quarterly summary forfeits credit and incurs penalty; mitigated by quarterly compilation SLA
System Touchpoints: - Book compilation; quarterly summary template; eFPS submission

steps.activity: Tax Accountant compiles Book of Sales/Transactions for SC/PWD per location (or aggregated per BIR tolerance); validates against POS register
Tax Manager prepares quarterly SC/PWD Book-of-Sales summary report per RR 7-2010; reviews completeness
Tax Manager submits the SC/PWD quarterly summary to BIR/DOF via eFPS/letter; archives confirmation; tracks acknowledgment

fields.Participants: Tax Manager, Tax Accountant, External Counsel

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Accountant prepares TCC application with supporting schedules" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "files TCC application with BIR" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "tracks TCC issuance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-486 (ensure controlled execution — Tax Credit Recovery, Registry Reporting & Audit Defense (PA-85.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Recovery risk**: Delayed/declined TCC ties up cash; mitigated by complete documentation and follow-up
System Touchpoints: - TCC application tracker; TCC utilization ledger

steps.activity: Tax Accountant prepares TCC application with supporting schedules (accumulated SC/PWD credit, 2552 history, VAT returns)
Tax Manager files TCC application with BIR; responds to BIR verification queries; coordinates with External Counsel for complex cases
Tax Manager tracks TCC issuance; applies TCC against future tax liabilities or pursues cash refund; books utilization

workflows.name: LGU Local Tax Credit & Real Property Tax Exemption Coordination

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "discounts granted to SC/PWD within their jurisdiction" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "Regulatory Officer coordinates with LGU Treasurer" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "tracks jurisdiction-by-jurisdiction outcomes" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-486 (ensure controlled execution — Tax Credit Recovery, Registry Reporting & Audit Defense (PA-85.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Recovery risk**: Inconsistent LGU practice; mitigated by per-LGU engagement and documentation

steps.activity: Tax Manager identifies LGU local-tax-credit opportunities (some LGUs grant credit for mandatory discounts granted to SC/PWD within their jurisdiction)
Regulatory Officer coordinates with LGU Treasurer; submits documentation; pursues credit against LBT/RPT where available
Finance books any LGU credit; tracks jurisdiction-by-jurisdiction outcomes; refines annual claim strategy

workflows.name: Discount Cost Allocation, Store Margin Impact & Reimbursement Policy

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Finance allocates net mandatory-discount cost" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "reviews assortment/pricing response" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-486 (ensure controlled execution — Tax Credit Recovery, Registry Reporting & Audit Defense (PA-85.3).)
- operational: tax-credit recovery and manufacturer reimbursement
Pain Points / Risks: - **Margin risk**: Unrecovered discount erodes margin; mitigated by tax-credit recovery and manufacturer reimbursement
System Touchpoints: - Cost allocation engine; store P&L; reimbursement tracker

steps.activity: Finance allocates net mandatory-discount cost (gross discount less tax credit recovered) to store/category P&L
FP&A analyzes store margin impact; identifies stores with high discount concentration; reviews assortment/pricing response
Store Ops/Finance reviews reimbursement policy for any manufacturer-funded portion (some brands reimburse retailer for senior discounts); claims recovery

fields.Participants: Tax Manager, External Counsel, Store Ops, IT

workflows.name: BIR Audit of Statutory Discount Books & Tax Credit Defense

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "records, ID-capture evidence, and 2552 history per audit scope" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "documentation gaps, eligibility disputes" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-update of "updates controls to prevent recurrence" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-486 (ensure controlled execution — Tax Credit Recovery, Registry Reporting & Audit Defense (PA-85.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Financial risk**: Disallowed credits require repayment with surcharge; mitigated by rigorous documentation
System Touchpoints: - Audit evidence repository; tax controversy tracker

steps.activity: Tax Manager gathers mandatory books, POS records, ID-capture evidence, and 2552 history per audit scope
External Counsel defends tax-credit claims against BIR challenge (documentation gaps, eligibility disputes); negotiates resolution
Tax Manager settles any disallowed credits; updates controls to prevent recurrence; archives audit outcome

fields.Trigger: New law/IRR (e.g., RA 11861, RA 10754 IRR amendments)

workflows.name: Mandatory Discount Regulatory Change Monitoring & Policy Update

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Compliance monitors legislation/IRR affecting mandatory discounts" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-update of "updates POS rule configuration and eligible-SKU mapping" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "validates first-cycle compliance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-486 (ensure controlled execution — Tax Credit Recovery, Registry Reporting & Audit Defense (PA-85.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Delayed implementation violates new law; mitigated by monitoring and pre-effective-date cutover
System Touchpoints: - Regulatory monitoring; rule-config change; training LMS

steps.activity: Compliance monitors legislation/IRR affecting mandatory discounts (rate changes, eligible-SKU scope, ID rules); assesses impact
Pricing/IT updates POS rule configuration and eligible-SKU mapping; tests before effective date; trains staff
Tax Manager updates policy and training; communicates change to stores; validates first-cycle compliance

workflows.name: Statutory Discount Program KPI, Cost & Compliance Reporting

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "discount transaction volume, gross discount granted, tax credit recovered, net…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validates program compliance" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report to Executive Committee" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-486 (ensure controlled execution — Tax Credit Recovery, Registry Reporting & Audit Defense (PA-85.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Strategic risk**: Unmeasured program cost; mitigated by quarterly KPI reporting
System Touchpoints: - Program KPI dashboard; cost/recovery analytics; compliance tracker

steps.activity: Finance compiles program KPIs: discount transaction volume, gross discount granted, tax credit recovered, net cost, complaint count, audit findings
Compliance reports regulatory posture (DTI/NCSC inquiries, BIR audit status); validates program compliance
Finance/Tax Manager report to Executive Committee; recommend program optimization (recovery rate, cost-to-serve)
